{
  "schema_version": "13.0",
  "description": "Externalized validation rules for LIC v13.0 - All error codes, thresholds, and validation logic",
  
  "error_code_registry": {
    "LIC-E001": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Placeholder detected in generated message",
      "remediation": "Regenerate with explicit anti-placeholder constraint"
    },
    "LIC-E002": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Per-claim confidence below threshold (0.70)",
      "remediation": "Add more RAG sources or remove low-confidence claim"
    },
    "LIC-E003": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Hallucinated claim without supporting evidence",
      "remediation": "Remove claim or add supporting RAG evidence"
    },
    "LIC-E004": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Message too similar to previous message (>0.85)",
      "remediation": "Increase temperature or add diversity constraint"
    },
    "LIC-E005": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Job title not in first 50 words",
      "remediation": "Regenerate with job title positioning constraint"
    },
    "LIC-E006": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Company name misspelled",
      "remediation": "Use exact company name from profile"
    },
    "LIC-E007": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Non-ASCII characters detected",
      "remediation": "Replace Unicode with ASCII equivalents"
    },
    "LIC-E008": {
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "description": "Forbidden corporate verbs detected",
      "remediation": "Regenerate avoiding: spearheaded, leveraged, etc."
    },
    "LIC-E009": {
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "description": "Weak filler phrases detected",
      "remediation": "Remove: 'I hope', 'I wanted to', 'just reaching out'"
    },
    "LIC-E010": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Metric lacks supporting keyword context from RAG",
      "remediation": "Add RAG evidence keywords around metric or remove metric"
    },
    "LIC-E011": {
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "description": "Signal quality score below threshold (0.70)",
      "remediation": "Trigger RAG reflexion for more research"
    },
    "LIC-E012": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Circuit breaker OPEN - API unavailable",
      "remediation": "Wait for circuit breaker timeout or check API"
    },
    "LIC-E013": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Constraint pre-flight check failed",
      "remediation": "Adjust constraints or change route"
    },
    "LIC-E014": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Forbidden voice phrase detected",
      "remediation": "Regenerate avoiding sender_voice_profile forbidden phrases"
    },
    "LIC-E015": {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "description": "Strategic alignment failure - no keyword overlap with strategic brief",
      "remediation": "Trigger S6->S2 meta-loop to re-research strategic brief alignment"
    }
  },
  
  "content_cleanliness_rules": {
    "forbidden_verbs": {
      "list": [
        "spearheaded",
        "leveraged",
        "utilized",
        "facilitated",
        "orchestrated",
        "championed",
        "pioneered",
        "revolutionized",
        "transformed",
        "optimized",
        "enhanced",
        "streamlined",
        "synergized",
        "enabled",
        "empowered",
        "drove",
        "drive"
      ],
      "max_violations": 1,
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-FORBIDDEN-VERBS",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "error_code": "LIC-E008"
    },
    "filler_patterns": {
      "patterns": [
        "(?i)\\bi hope\\b",
        "(?i)\\bhope (this|you) (finds|are|don't)",
        "(?i)\\bi (wanted|would like) to (reach|connect|discuss|share)",
        "(?i)\\bi was wondering if",
        "(?i)\\bperhaps (we|you) could",
        "(?i)\\bif you('re| are) interested",
        "(?i)\\bjust (wanted|reaching|following)"
      ],
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-FILLERS",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "error_code": "LIC-E009"
    },
    "placeholder_patterns": {
      "patterns": [
        "\\[.*?\\]",
        "\\{.*?\\}",
        "<.*?>",
        "PLACEHOLDER",
        "TODO",
        "XXX"
      ],
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-PLACEHOLDERS",
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "error_code": "LIC-E001"
    }
  },
  
  "ascii_enforcement": {
    "unicode_replacements": {
      "\\u2013": "-",
      "\\u2014": "-",
      "\\u2018": "'",
      "\\u2019": "'",
      "\\u201c": "\"",
      "\\u201d": "\"",
      "\\u2026": "..."
    },
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-055",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E007"
  },
  
  "signal_quality_scoring": {
    "source_weights": {
      "RECIPIENT_LINKEDIN_ABOUT": 1.0,
      "RECIPIENT_RECENT_POST": 0.95,
      "RECIPIENT_COMMENT": 0.85,
      "COMPANY_BLOG_ANNOUNCEMENT": 0.9,
      "COMPANY_PRESS_RELEASE": 0.85,
      "NEWS_ARTICLE": 0.75,
      "NEWS_ARTICLE_COMPANY": 0.75,
      "INDUSTRY_REPORT": 0.7,
      "CONFERENCE_TALK": 0.8,
      "GITHUB_ACTIVITY": 0.75,
      "TWITTER_POST": 0.6,
      "GENERIC_SEARCH": 0.4,
      "STRATEGIC_BRIEF": 1.0,
      "MASTER_RESUME": 1.0,
      "SENDER_KNOWLEDGE_BASE": 1.0
    },
    "recency_decay_days": 90,
    "min_signal_threshold": 0.7,
    "recency_factors": {
      "0-7_days": 1.0,
      "8-30_days": 0.95,
      "31-90_days": 0.85,
      "91-180_days": 0.7,
      "180+_days": 0.5
    },
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-SIGNAL-QUALITY",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E011"
  },
  
  "claim_confidence_scoring": {
    "min_claim_confidence": 0.7,
    "min_overlap_words": 2,
    "base_confidence_multiplier": 1.5,
    "source_boost_per_source": 0.1,
    "max_source_boost": 0.3,
    "no_source_penalty": 0.5,
    "min_claim_words": 3,
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-106",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "error_code": "LIC-E002"
  },
  
  "message_diversity_validation": {
    "similarity_threshold": 0.85,
    "ledger_file": "message_ledger.json",
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-MESSAGE-DIVERSITY",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "error_code": "LIC-E004"
  },
  
  "sender_grounding_validation": {
    "team_keywords": [
      "my team",
      "our team",
      "we built",
      "we developed",
      "our work",
      "we created"
    ],
    "product_keywords": [
      "our product",
      "our platform",
      "our system",
      "our solution"
    ],
    "case_study_keywords": [
      "we helped",
      "client",
      "case study"
    ],
    "rule_ids": {
      "team": "LIC-QA-105-TEAM",
      "product": "LIC-QA-105-PRODUCT",
      "case": "LIC-QA-105-CASE"
    },
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "error_code": "LIC-E003"
  },
  
  "strategic_alignment_validation": {
    "min_keyword_overlap": 3,
    "min_keyword_length": 4,
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-201",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "error_code": "LIC-E015",
    "failure_classifier": "FACTUAL_FAILURE",
    "_comment": "v12.0 MASTER RULE: Ensures message aligns with strategic brief, triggers S6->S2 meta-loop on failure"
  },
  
  "voice_profile_validation": {
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-200-VOICE",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E014",
    "_comment": "Validates against sender_voice_profile.json forbidden phrases"
  },
  
  "job_title_placement_validation": {
    "first_n_words": 50,
    "applicable_routes": ["INMAIL"],
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-075",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E005"
  },
  
  "company_spelling_validation": {
    "max_levenshtein_distance": 2,
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-049",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E006"
  },
  
  "metric_validation": {
    "metric_patterns": [
      "\\d+%",
      "\\d+x",
      "\\$\\d+[KMB]",
      "\\d+ (years?|months?|days?)"
    ],
    "context_window_words": 10,
    "min_supporting_keywords": 2,
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-METRIC-CONTEXT",
    "severity": "HIGH",
    "error_code": "LIC-E010"
  },
  
  "constraint_feasibility_rules": {
    "min_words_per_element": {
      "CONNECTION_REQ": 8,
      "INMAIL": 5,
      "EMAIL": 5,
      "FOLLOW_UP": 5
    },
    "buffer_elements": 2,
    "rule_id": "LIC-QA-FEASIBILITY",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "error_code": "LIC-E013"
  },
  
  "structural_validation": {
    "word_count": {
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-WORD-COUNT",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "tolerance_percentage": 0.1,
      "_comment": "Validates message is within ±10% of target word count"
    },
    "char_limit": {
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-CHAR-LIMIT",
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "_comment": "Validates message does not exceed route char_limit"
    },
    "subject_line": {
      "rule_id": "LIC-QA-SUBJECT",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "min_words": 4,
      "max_words": 10,
      "_comment": "Validates subject line for routes that require it"
    }
  },
  
  "factual_failure_rules": {
    "_comment": "Rules that trigger FACTUAL_FAILURE classification, causing S6->S2 meta-loop",
    "factual_rule_ids": [
      "LIC-QA-201",
      "LIC-QA-106",
      "LIC-QA-105",
      "LIC-QA-043",
      "LIC-QA-003"
    ]
  },
  
  "validation_severity_thresholds": {
    "critical_halt": true,
    "high_halt": true,
    "medium_regenerate": true,
    "info_log_only": true,
    "_comment": "Defines behavior for each severity level"
  },
  
  "qa_scoring": {
    "perfect_score": 100,
    "critical_penalty": 50,
    "high_penalty": 20,
    "medium_penalty": 5,
    "info_penalty": 0,
    "minimum_passing_score": 70,
    "_comment": "Scoring system for QA report"
  },
  
  "validation_execution_order": {
    "_comment": "Order in which validation rules are executed (CRITICAL rules first)",
    "priority_1_critical": [
      "LIC-QA-200-VOICE",
      "LIC-QA-201",
      "LIC-QA-PLACEHOLDERS",
      "LIC-QA-106",
      "LIC-QA-MESSAGE-DIVERSITY",
      "LIC-QA-105-TEAM",
      "LIC-QA-105-PRODUCT",
      "LIC-QA-105-CASE"
    ],
    "priority_2_high": [
      "LIC-QA-075",
      "LIC-QA-049",
      "LIC-QA-055",
      "LIC-QA-METRIC-CONTEXT",
      "LIC-QA-SIGNAL-QUALITY"
    ],
    "priority_3_medium": [
      "LIC-QA-FORBIDDEN-VERBS",
      "LIC-QA-FILLERS"
    ],
    "priority_4_structural": [
      "LIC-QA-WORD-COUNT",
      "LIC-QA-CHAR-LIMIT",
      "LIC-QA-SUBJECT"
    ]
  },
  
  "temperature_escalation_strategy": {
    "_comment": "Adaptive temperature control for creative failure retry (S5)",
    "base_temperatures": {
      "C_LEVEL": 0.45,
      "EXECUTIVE": 0.5,
      "SENIOR_TA": 0.55,
      "RECRUITER": 0.65
    },
    "escalation_increment": 0.1,
    "max_temperature": 0.9,
    "max_creative_retries": 3
  }
}
